answer.book: Johannis Jonstoni Polyhistor seu Rerum ab exortu universi ad nostra usque tempora (1660): a universal history in three parts (Antemonarchicorum; Monarchiarum orientalium; Monarchia Romana indivulsa), each in books, chapters and articles, preceded by dedication, preface and encomia.
